notes.title: Tactical Battles – Massive Update: New Skills, Recap Battles & More!
notes.notes: [p]The battlefield just got better! This new update for [i]Tactical Battles[/i] brings powerful new skills with varying ranges to master, a [b]Recap Battle[/b] screen so you can review your strategies after each fight, and improved controls with a brand-new camera rotation input. Plus, several bug fixes to keep the action smooth and immersive. Sharpen your tactics and dominate the battlefield—wishlist [i]Tactical Battles[/i] on Steam today![/p]
